quest.title: Noelle Rides Out
quest.description: Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, she decides to emulate the knights she knows in an attempt to overcome her sense of unease.

talks.objective: Go to the Stormbearer Mountains and gather fresh Valberries
Defeat the Pyro Slimes and gather Slime Condensate
Head to the hilichurl camp and place the Baron Bunny
